name: laguna-beach
description: Laguna Beach, CA permits end to end — decide what to file, check compliance, fill the official City forms, and guide a user-controlled Tyler EnerGov filing through receipt capture.

interface.shortDescription: Scope, check, fill and file Laguna Beach permits
interface.longDescription: One plugin for Laguna Beach, CA. Scopes your project, routes it to the right Planning entitlement or Building record under LBMC, checks it against state code plus local amendments, fills the official City applications from SHA-pinned current revisions, and guides a user-controlled EnerGov filing. Never submits without fresh explicit approval.
defaultPrompt: Use $laguna-permit-preparer to decide what I need, prepare the official forms, and guide me to a portal-ready Laguna Beach permit packet.
